title: Version the complete project-local ontology state and byte-preserving inputs
summary: User authorized pushing all project work to origin/main for resuming on another device. Track installed suite, graph, durable records/proofs, agent entry points and original distribution snapshots as ordinary files. Preserve exact source/proof bytes through Git attributes. Build/dependency caches and nested .git metadata remain machine-local.
basis: core.autocrlf=true would rewrite source/proof hashes; bundled coordinator requires Python 3.10+ standard library only.
